Method of Attack: Scrapes RAM for payment card data
Sends collected data to C&C server as encoded and highly obfuscated DNS queries
Installed manually after compromising POS networks
Discoverer: Target Cyber Threat Intelligence & Detection Team
Impacted Systems: POS systems running x64 versions of Windows 7 or later
Indicators of Compromise: Encoded and obfuscated DNS queries to C&C server
